responsibility: Acts as the top-level RL78 machine description that introduces register and UNSPEC constants, includes the subsidiary predicate/constraint/expand/virtual/real md fragments, and defines target-wide core RTL patterns not confined to those fragments. It covers prologue/epilogue and return forms, push/pop, register-bank selection, trampolines, nonlocal goto support, ES-address construction, macro-style multi-instruction arithmetic and division patterns, hardware multiply/divide variants, and some libcall-based expansions, serving as the central md integration point for the RL78 backend.
same_name_distinction: Is the RL78 machine-description file that declaratively defines RTL expands, insns, attributes, and includes subordinate md fragments for instruction selection and expansion. This distinguishes it from rl78.cc, which implements supporting C++ logic and hooks, rl78.h, which supplies target macros and architectural definitions, and rl78.opt, which specifies option metadata.
